scope: Partial D06: durable password-login admission/audit, revision-bound browser sessions, installation-operator revocation, unused typed-approval cancellation. No project-role or release claim.

environment.host: macOS ARM64; disposable Linux Docker runners
environment.resources: Two CPUs per backend runner; OMP/OpenBLAS/MKL threads bounded at two. Datasets, rounds, assertions, skip/coverage budgets unchanged. Provider keys blank, engine unavailable, telemetry disabled; optional SDK absent.

checks.name: Full SQLite marked suite, Ruff, migration drift and pip consistency
Authentication, sessions and typed-action focused checks
checks.evidence: Includes 32 new cases in the full suites: audit/admission/commit failures, source/pair budgets and reset, account-change denial, legacy/unavailable authority, admin/API shared admission, logout outage, revocation/re-login, unused-approval cancellation, mid-prepare revocation, replay/conflict and MCP actor deactivation. Completed/denied event chronology is asserted on real authentication/revocation flows.

checks.name: Independent PostgreSQL processes under private TLS
checks.evidence: Database verify-full TLS, current-bucket denial aggregation, five-process shared source/principal limits, one same-UUID revocation commit across five commands, two denied old sessions, unaffected user and fresh-session replay preservation. Finalized receipts are also checked for ordered timestamps.

checks.name: Private middleware/session/API, TLS negatives and synthetic persistence/restore
checks.evidence: Non-superuser migrations, HTTPS/Host/secure-cookie/CSRF checks, certificate and hostname rejection. Authentication login receipt/current revision joins the existing metadata/session/grant/approval/holdout/artifact checks across restart and quiescent matching database/artifact restore. Real Django middleware/client and PostgreSQL TLS; no live TLS browser ingress claim.

checks.name: Real development browser revocation and retry workflow
checks.evidence: Built Angular assets against disposable Django/SQLite on loopback. Three independent browser contexts use real username/password/CSRF sessions. Revocation denies the affected user's two sessions at REST/media and returns their UI to login; another actor stays authenticated; fresh login survives same-UUID retry. No external requests or runtime page errors.

checks.name: Angular production build
checks.evidence: Existing bundle/CommonJS warnings retained; frontend source and dependencies unchanged.

checks.name: Final backend and fixture static checks
Canonical roadmap projection and ledger invariants
Development Compose admission configuration
checks.evidence: Explicit non-default window/pair/source limits from a disposable env file reach the backend service; validation reads configuration only and never starts or alters the primary stack.

qualification_corrections: Initial script static checks found two import-order issues and a loop closure warning. Imports and bound closure fixed; final static checks pass without changing fixture scenarios.
Local host Python has no pytest; ledger checks use the same qualified core runner as backend checks.

Final review found default start timestamps could follow explicit finish timestamps for instant receipt creation. Capture starts before operations, assert finalized chronology in native and private PostgreSQL flows, and rerun all focused/full/database/browser checks on corrected source.
Development Compose now forwards the three admission controls documented in .env.example; a disposable configuration-only override check passes.
ci: All six existing CI jobs remain. The PostgreSQL job additionally executes the five-process private identity fixture. Exact-head CI is recorded by the PR separately from local source evidence.
limitations: Project authorization and developer/reviewer/admin roles, SSO/MFA/enrollment, egress/retention, tamper-proof audit and full threat-model qualification remain open.
Existing unbound browser sessions and pending approvals require reauthentication or fresh preparation/review. No invented historical provenance.

Operator label is asserted installation metadata, not authenticated human identity. Browser revocation alone does not revoke MCP grants/process scopes; --deactivate blocks the configured actor active-account check.

Events distinguish API login commit, credential validation and session binding; interrupted admitted attempts can remain pending. Repeated throttled attempts aggregate only in the current bucket window.
Already-authorized handlers/jobs and dispatching/completed/failed receipts are preserved. Durable worker cancellation/recovery is not delivered.

No live private TLS ingress, online coordinated restore, SQLite-to-PostgreSQL transfer, encrypted/offline packaging, expert isolation, independent reproduction, customer capacity, delivery-date or acceptance claim. All release/customer gates remain open.
